issue_context.summary: Quick Accent selection bar does not appear on a second screen while typing in a document.

Current Quick Accent source contains multi-monitor placement code and tests; that is not shipped-fix evidence.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that the document is on a secondary screen and the bar does not appear there. Quick Accent already has monitor-aware placement in current source, so the missing details are display arrangement/scaling and how the bar is triggered. Please share which monitor is primary, each display’s Windows scaling percentage, and the exact key sequence used while the editor is on the secondary screen. This distinguishes wrong-monitor selection from a DPI-coordinate mismatch.
